entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The Hualei platform's own row on the order's creation time: the shipment data has arrived.
Booked into the warehouse at the receiving point.

entries.wording: 已出库,货物离开操作中心
entries.note: Booked out: the parcel has left the operations centre.
Export customs clearance in China is under way.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场，等待安排航班中The goods have been delivered to the airport and are awaiting the arrangement of flights.
entries.note: Handed to the airport to wait for a flight. It is not a delivery to the recipient, though a translation may read 'Delivered'.
The flight has left the origin.
Arrived in the destination country or region.

entries.wording: 清关完成，待转运Clearance has been completed and it is awaiting transfer.
entries.note: Cleared at the destination and waiting to be handed to the delivering carrier.
Handed to the delivering carrier, whose number the tracker then shows.
